slides.title: Light day. You said it out loud.
slides.body: To your partner, the coach and the car on the way in. Witnesses everywhere.

slides.title: The next rack loads 100kg.
slides.body: You weren't going to look. You looked. You did some quick maths.

slides.title: "Just one more plate."
slides.body: For feel. Nothing serious. You're only checking the bar path.

slides.title: Coach walks past. Slowly.
slides.body: Says nothing. Writes nothing down. Somehow that's worse.

slides.title: Your partner films the last set.
slides.body: You tell them not to. You watch the video four times in the car.

slides.title: The stairs have opinions.
slides.body: Tomorrow is a light day. You mean it this time. Probably.
